algorithm.name: Proximal Random Reshuffling (ProxRR) and Federated Random Reshuffling (FedRR)
citations: PDF p.1 Eq.(1) and Assumption 1: composite finite-sum objective.
PDF p.2: proximal operator definition; p.3 Algorithm 1 lines 3-7: ProxRR.
PDF p.7 Eq.(13) and Algorithm 3 lines 4-9: product-space reformulation and FedRR.
PDF p.8 Eq.(14): logistic regression with elastic net.
PDF p.21, Proximal operator calculation: elastic-net shrinkage and soft threshold.
assumptions: These are synthetic deterministic algorithm experiments derived only from the original PDF, not benchmark recreation or claims about statistical convergence.
All page numbers are one-based physical PDF pages. Original is arXiv:2102.06704v1 dated 12 Feb 2021.
All component objectives are smooth and convex, and all regularizers are proper closed convex elastic nets. Quadratic maximum smoothness is 4; all chosen quadratic stepsizes are at most 1/4.
Supplied order lists fix realizations of reshuffling randomness. Each list is a full permutation; no RNG seed convention is needed.
ProxRR gamma_t is supplied explicitly and is constant within each epoch, as allowed by Algorithm 1. The test does not invoke the specific theoretical schedule in Eq.(11).
The federated test follows the general unequal-sample Algorithm 3; the equal-sample restrictions of later convergence theorems are not imposed on the algorithm.
Coverage focuses on Algorithms 1 and 3. Shuffle-Once, importance resampling, convergence bounds and empirical performance claims are outside this finite numeric contract.

cases.purpose: Order-sensitive convex component steps, changing epoch learning rates, and exactly one n-scaled elastic-net prox per epoch.

parameters.objective_normalization: P(x)=(1/n)*sum_i f_i(x)+psi(x). Component gradients are NOT divided by n.
parameters.prox_convention: prox_(alpha psi)(v)=argmin_z alpha*psi(z)+0.5*||z-v||_2^2; coordinate result is sign(v_j)*max(abs(v_j)-alpha*lambda1,0)/(1+alpha*lambda2).
parameters.permutation_policy: Condition on the explicitly supplied permutation for each epoch; do not generate or sort a different order.
parameters.gradient_evaluation: At the latest inner iterate; no prox or added regularizer gradient inside an epoch.

observations.step: One-based completed epoch; step 1 is t=0.
observations.inner_iterates: Rows are x_t^1 through x_t^n in supplied sample order, before any regularizer operation.
observations.iterate: x_(t+1), after the single epoch-end proximal operation.

cases.purpose: Use the paper experimental logistic objective with nonzero positive and negative margins and a genuinely active soft threshold that zeros a coordinate after every epoch.

inputs.loss: f_i(x)=-b_i*log(h(a_i^T*x))-(1-b_i)*log(1-h(a_i^T*x)); h(s)=1/(1+exp(-s)); gradient=(h(a_i^T*x)-b_i)*a_i. No intercept is added.

parameters.objective_normalization: P(x)=(1/n)*sum_i f_i(x)+psi(x). Component gradients are NOT divided by n.
parameters.prox_convention: prox_(alpha psi)(v)=argmin_z alpha*psi(z)+0.5*||z-v||_2^2; coordinate result is sign(v_j)*max(abs(v_j)-alpha*lambda1,0)/(1+alpha*lambda2).
parameters.permutation_policy: Condition on the explicitly supplied permutation for each epoch; do not generate or sort a different order.
parameters.gradient_evaluation: At the latest inner iterate; no prox or added regularizer gradient inside an epoch.

observations.step: One-based completed epoch; step 1 is t=0.
observations.inner_iterates: Rows are x_t^1 through x_t^n in supplied sample order, before any regularizer operation.
observations.iterate: x_(t+1), after the single epoch-end proximal operation.

cases.purpose: Exercise independent local full passes on heterogeneous clients with unequal sample counts, reset from the preceding global iterate, equal device weighting and gamma*N/M regularization.

parameters.objective_normalization: P(x)=(1/N)*sum_m sum_i f_mi(x)+R(x). Each local sample gradient is unnormalized.
parameters.prox_convention: prox_(alpha R)(v)=argmin_z alpha*R(z)+0.5*||z-v||_2^2; coordinate result is sign(v_j)*max(abs(v_j)-alpha*lambda1,0)/(1+alpha*lambda2).
parameters.permutation_policy: Use the given order separately for each client and epoch. The order lists contain only real samples.
parameters.local_update: Each round begins with every client at x_t. Client m performs N_m sequential sample gradient steps with constant gamma and no regularizer. For padding to n=max_m N_m, dummy losses have zero gradient and leave the completed local state unchanged.
parameters.server_update: z_(t+1)=(1/M)*sum_m local_endpoint_m; x_(t+1)=prox_(gamma*N/M*R)(z_(t+1)). All clients participate in every round.

observations.step: One-based completed communication round; step 1 is t=0.
observations.local_after_first_sample: Rows are the two clients, each after its first real sample gradient update in this round.
observations.local_endpoints: Rows are the two clients after all their real sample updates, before aggregation.
observations.aggregate: Equal-weight mean z_(t+1) of completed client vectors before regularization.
observations.iterate: Global x_(t+1) after server proximal operation.
